_about: DECISIONS 373 (Efsa, A8): rules not yet approved by the SEO team. A finding of a questioned rule, or of a draft sector check on an audit of that sector's profile, is shown as "Kontrol edin" (warning), never as a definite "Sorun", until the team approves it here (move it to "approved" with who and when). Severity and order do not change.

idx5.stamped.note: Nature's Garden J6: how is the lastmod error detected? The verdict (the file's generation time, not real edits) is an inference from every address sharing one timestamp.

policy._about: DECISIONS 378: what a finding of a rule the team has not approved becomes: "card" (shown as today) or "confirm" (waits in "Teyit edin" until approved). A rule whose latest reviewed card was wrong, or that is under "questioned", always waits.
